sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajendra Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Neeraj Tiwari,J.
1.

Sri Pankaj Kumar Tiwari, Advocate, put in appearance on behalf of opposite party No. 2 has filed
vakalatnama, which is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and Sri Pankaj Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2.
3.

The present 528 BNSS application has been filed to quash the charge sheet dated 03.01.2022,
summoning order dated 04.03.2022 as well as entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 333 of 2022(State of U.P. Vs. Ritesh Jaiswala and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 206 of 2021, under Ritesh Jaiswal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167246892/
1 Sections- 498A, 323 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Chakia, District- Chandauli, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Chakia, District-Chandauli.

entities.text: Ritesh Jaiswal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Earlier applicants have filed Application U/s 482 No. 454 of 2025, which was disposed of vide order dated 17.03.2025 with direction to court below to verify the compromise so filed by the applicants.

5. Pursuant to order dated 17.03.2025 passed in Application U/s 482 No. 454 of 2025, compromise dated 25.10.2024 has been verified by the trial Court vide order dated 22.05.2025 and the same has been annexed as Annexure-(9) to the application.
6. Learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2 has not objected the aforesaid facts and submitted that in case proceedings against the applicants is quashed, he would have no objection.
7. In view of the facts and circumstances of the case, the applicants and opposite party no. 2 do not want to pursue the case any further as stated by them.
The matter has been mutually settled between the parties, therefore, no useful purpose would be served in proceeding with the matter further.

8. Thus in view of the well settled principle of law as laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the matters of Krishnappa & Ors. vs. State of Karnataka; 2021 0 Supreme(SC) 529, Parbatbhai Aahir @
Parbatbhai Bhimsinhbhai Karmur and Ors. vs. State of Gujarat and another; 2017 9 SCC 641, B.S.
Joshi Vs. State of Haryana; 2003(4) SCC 675, Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Burea of Investigation and another; (2008) 9 Supreme Court Cases 677, Gian Singh Vs. Stated of Punjab; (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & others Vs. State of Punjab and another; (2014) Supreme Today 642, the proceedings of the aforesaid case is hereby quashed.
